svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Gated pipeline
svg.desc: Six gate stages run in order; a failing stage rejects the change before an Exit-0 receipt is signed.

Security & SCA Scan","sub":"govulncheck, gosec","width":250},{"id":"s4","label":"4. Flavor Conformance","sub":"flavor audit","width":250},{"id":"s5","label":"5. Race-Detector Tests","sub":"go test -race in a worktree","width":250},{"id":"s6","label":"6. Ed25519 Exit-0 Receipt","sub":"signs the stage output","width":250}]},{"direction":"column","gap":40,"children":[{"id":"reject","label":"Rejected","sub":"exit 1, stage named"},{"id":"receipt","label":".standards-receipt.json","sub":"Exit-0 receipt","shape":"store"}]}]},"edges":[{"from":"candidate","to":"s1","label":"clean tree"},{"from":"s1","to":"s2"},{"from":"s2","to":"s3"},{"from":"s3","to":"s4"},{"from":"s4","to":"s5"},{"from":"s5","to":"s6"},{"from":"key","to":"s6","label":"LoadSigningKey"},{"from":"s6","to":"receipt","label":"signed"},{"id":"s1-fail","from":"s1","to":"reject","label":"lockfile/checksum","quiet":true},{"id":"hiss-fail","from":"s2","to":"reject","label":"HISS findings or missing scanner","quiet":true},{"id":"s3-fail","from":"s3","to":"reject","label":"vulnerabilities or missing scanner","quiet":true},{"id":"s4-fail","from":"s4","to":"reject","label":"flavor score below the bar or missing template","quiet":true},{"id":"s5-fail","from":"s5","to":"reject","label":"race/test failure","quiet":true},{"id":"key-fail","from":"s6","to":"reject","label":"no signing key","quiet":true}],"steps":[{"label":"clean run","caption":"Every stage passes and the receipt is signed.","flow":[{"edges":"candidate->s1","say":"The tree matches HEAD."},{"edges":"s1->s2","say":"Lockfiles found; g.text: flavor score below the bar or missing template
No HISS violation beyond the baseline.
The stage output is signed for this commit.
The ratchet finds a violation beyond the baseline; the gate exits 1.
The tree may differ from HEAD.
VerifyLockfiles finds a checksum that does not match .standards.lock; the gate exits 1.
govulncheck or gosec reports a vulnerability, or the scanner itself is missing; the gate exits 1.
The flavor audit score falls below the bar, or the template is missing; the gate exits 1.
go test -race fails in the worktree; the gate exits 1.
No PRAETOR_RECEIPT_KEY and no key file: the stage fails and nothing is signed.
